documents.text: Returns are accepted within 30 days when the customer provides an order number.
Refunds are issued to the original payment method after the returned item is inspected.

candidate.answer: Returns are accepted within 30 days with an order number. Refunds go to the original payment method after inspection.

documents.text: Standard delivery normally arrives in three to five business days.
Expedited delivery is available only in the continental United States.

candidate.answer: Standard delivery arrives in three to five business days and expedited service is available worldwide.
